annotations.title: Check a supplier invoice before paying, incl. changed bank details (paid)

description: Use before an agent pays a supplier invoice: supplier in official registers; company, directors, owners and parents screened (EU, UN, UK, US sanctions, PEP); VAT match; IBAN valid, same country, on the Polish whitelist; sender email; Dutch bankruptcy; Peppol. With known_iban, a different bank account than the one on file puts it on hold. Verdict: pass, review or hold. Costs 0.08 USDC via x402, or 40 credits of a Factline API key.

country.description: Supplier's ISO country, e.g. BE, NL, GB, PL

email.description: Email address the invoice came from

iban.description: IBAN the invoice asks you to pay

known_iban.description: The supplier's IBAN in your vendor master: a different IBAN on the invoice puts it on hold (changed bank details)

kvk.description: Dutch KvK number: adds a bankruptcy check

name.description: Supplier company name, e.g. Colruyt Group
